title: Finish preview setup teaching
text: JOURNEYS owns the deeper executable preview setup branch: supported Pack prerequisites, hosting/routing/application configuration, access/data, candidate identity, QA binding, lifetime and cleanup ownership. The existing lessons distinguish a changing branch target from a frozen release candidate and name current Pack sources. An existing supported target remains a valid choice; unsupported/deferred setup stays visible. This open teaching gap provides no preview provisioning or actual QA proof.
